m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Traitors! Balor say... come with us to jail and execution. Or else we kill you now!
:Crrrk: Foolish creature, I am Nadezha the SpiceSeer, one of the ruling members of the Troika. I order you-
Silence! Balor say take you, too!
Hisss! We tell Balor! Get you another time!
I cannot believe what just happened! This is impossible! Let us see what is happening on the street.
Still quiet out here, good. I was afraid there might be open fighting.
I truly did not expect you to say anything that would have changed my mind or my allegiance, Spellbinder.
But Warlord Balor has turned me fully to your side.
You seem wary, anxious. What do you think is going to happen here? I will make some tea, and you will tell me what you need to.
Tell me of where you come from, or what you saw on the far side of the Starfall Sea, or what you believe the Shadow Queen desires.
I mean, I did not expect to see you again. You defeated Drepa HookTip and freed Zed? :Crrrk: Is it wise to tell me this?
Zed specifically told you to talk to me about the monks of Lost Light, and the Fifth Column, and the Shadow Queen? :Crrrk:
The open air is no place for this kind of talk. Come inside.
Come inside with me to discuss these highly charged subjects. Why do you hesitate?
